name: UI：视频上传节点-非法输入边界(非数字商品ID+非法视频URL)
description: 验证视频上传节点对非法输入的校验：商品ID输入非数字字符、视频URL输入非法字符串时的前端校验行为

steps.expression: return (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a,button')).filter(el => el.textContent.trim() === '打开'); if(btns.length > 0) { btns[0].click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'no open btn'; })()

return (() => { const modals = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-modal'); for (const m of modals) { if (m.classList.contains('ant-modal-hidden')) continue; const r = m.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width < 200) continue; const cards = m.querySelectorAll('.ant-card-hoverable, .ant-card'); for (const card of cards) { const t = card.querySelector('.ant-card-meta-title'); if (t && t.textContent.trim() === '视频上传') { card.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); card.click(); return { ok: true }; } } } return { ok: false }; })()

steps.description: 等待视频上传编辑抽屉加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { open: false }; const formItems = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')); const itemIdItem = formItems.find(i => { const label = (i.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || ''); return label.includes('商品ID') || label.includes('商品'); }); if (!itemIdItem) return { open: true, noItemId: true }; const inp = itemIdItem.querySelector('input'); if (!inp) return { open: true, noInput: true }; const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'abc!@#'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('blur', { bubbles: true })); return { open: true, filled: 'abc!@#' }; })()
steps.description: 向商品ID输入非数字字符并触发校验

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const errors = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item-explain-error, .ant-form-item-explain')); const errorTexts = errors.map(e => (e.textContent || '').trim()).filter(Boolean); const hasItemIdError = errorTexts.some(t => t.includes('商品') || t.includes('数字') || t.includes('必填') || t.includes('格式')); return { hasItemIdError, errorTexts, totalErrors: errors.length }; })()
steps.description: 检查商品ID非法输入校验结果

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { ok: false }; const formItems = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')); const videoItem = formItems.find(i => { const label = (i.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || ''); return label.includes('视频') && !label.includes('上传'); }); if (!videoItem) return { noVideo: true }; const inp = videoItem.querySelector('input'); if (!inp) return { noInput: true }; const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'not-a-valid-url'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('blur', { bubbles: true })); return { ok: true, filled: 'not-a-valid-url' }; })()
steps.description: 向视频字段输入非法URL并触发校验

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const errors = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item-explain-error, .ant-form-item-explain')); const errorTexts = errors.map(e => (e.textContent || '').trim()).filter(Boolean); const hasVideoError = errorTexts.some(t => t.includes('视频') || t.includes('URL') || t.includes('链接') || t.includes('格式')); return { hasVideoError, errorTexts, totalErrors: errors.length }; })()
steps.description: 检查视频非法URL校验结果

steps.expression: return (() => { const c = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden) .ant-drawer-close'); if(c) c.click(); return 'closed'; })()

_testDesign.realDomNotes: 商品ID为Input组件；视频字段为Input组件(URL输入)
riskPoints: 商品ID输入非数字字符时是否有前端校验提示
视频字段输入非法URL时是否有格式校验
输入特殊字符(XSS向量)时是否有转义处理
